candidates.rule: Killed tool calls were absent from logs, so tool-call logging must include calls that are blocked or killed.
candidates.quote: 죽인 툴 호출만 로그에 없었다.
candidates.harness: Log attempted tool calls, including calls that are killed or blocked.

candidates.rule: Tool descriptions served as the interface, so descriptions must accurately explain how tools are used.
candidates.quote: 툴 설명이 인터페이스였다
candidates.harness: Provide clear, accurate tool descriptions as the agent-facing interface.

candidates.rule: Adaptive stopping saved tokens; use a small default situation and invoke tools only when needed.
candidates.quote: 토큰을 아낀 것은 적응적 종료였다 | 작은 기본 상황, 필요할 때만 툴
candidates.harness: Support adaptive stopping and avoid unnecessary tool calls.

candidates.rule: Model-reported numbers and explanations diverged, so numerical results must come from a calculation tool.
candidates.quote: 모델이 보고한 숫자와 설명이 어긋났다 | 숫자는 계산 툴이 낸다
candidates.harness: Have calculation tools produce numerical results rather than trusting model-reported numbers.

candidates.rule: Output format alone did not ensure diligent work or correct termination; limits must be enforced by validation and execution tools.
candidates.quote: 형식은 성실성과 종료 규칙을 보장하지 않았다 | 한도는 검증·실행 툴
candidates.harness: Enforce limits and termination rules in validation and execution tools.

candidates.rule: The MCP approach exposes tools as servers and lets agents discover them through descriptions.
candidates.quote: MCP: 툴을 서버로, 설명으로 발견
candidates.harness: Expose tools through discoverable server descriptions.

candidates.rule: The design boundary assigns strategy to prompts, numbers to context, decisions to the model, and limits to code.
candidates.quote: 전략은 프롬프트, 숫자는 컨텍스트, 결정은 모델, 한도는 코드
candidates.harness: Keep strategy, factual numerical context, model decisions, and code-enforced limits in their assigned roles.

candidates.rule: Memory is written by code and selected by the model; a long prompt caused a timeout, and replacing memory with one sample was later reversed.
candidates.quote: 기억은 코드가 쓰고 모델이 고른다. 프롬프트가 길어 시간 초과. 표본 1건으로 바꿨다가 되돌림
candidates.harness: Let code write memory and the model select it; keep prompts short and do not reduce memory to one sample.

candidates.rule: Fake notices, advertisements embedded in reviews, and 429 rating-bombing were observed risks.
candidates.quote: 가짜 공지, 후기 속 광고, 429 별점 폭격
candidates.harness: Treat notices and reviews as untrusted input and guard against rating-bombing.

candidates.rule: The kit paid without knowing the agreed price, so checkout must verify the agreed price before payment.
candidates.quote: 키트는 합의가를 모르고 결제한다
candidates.harness: Do not pay at checkout until the agreed price is known and verified.

candidates.rule: As of 2026-11-03, the week-08 README and checker script did not exist; submission alignment must be checked again if they are created.
candidates.quote: 아직 없다. 생기면 그 기준으로 다시 맞춘다.
candidates.harness: Recheck the submission against the README and checker if either becomes available.
